description: Mean test ROC-AUC across 5 folds (Ru/Ir/Os/Rh/Re) × 5 seeds of multi-metal leave-one-metal-out transfer with W₂ transfer regularisation. STALE-PROSE FIXED (2026-10-08): the historical text said '2 folds (Rh, Re)' × N seeds with 'Rh closure-oversample'; the live real-only headline (rh_oversample=0, n_synthetic_rh_appended=0) is the 25-run 5-fold panel below, NOT a 2-fold oversampled run. See real_only_pa_m19_re_measurement_2026_10_08 for the provenance of the retracted 7-run/2-fold oversampled wave.
gate_target_provenance: INTERNAL -- 0.7 is our own GATE_AUC constant (train_metal_lomo_wasserstein.py). It is NOT a literature value. Krasnov 2026 reports its own MetalCytoToxDB numbers on a different cohort + different split; the 0.7577 headline is NOT compared numerically against Krasnov here.
value_is_half_synthetic_scope: FALSE for the live headline (value=0.5575). This flag was left at `true` after the Wf-R43 real-only re-measurement replaced the 0.7577 half-synthetic number, so it asserted a provenance the headline no longer had — the same defect class as the old `v3_cohort_median_REAL`. The half-synthetic number is still preserved, clearly labelled, under `synthetic_augmented_baseline_preserved_for_diff` (0.7577, Rh fold 0.8798). Evidence that the live panel is real-only: rh_oversample=0, n_synthetic_rh_appended=0, rh_cohort_source=null, verdict=..._REAL_ONLY, and `real_only_pa_m19_re_measurement_2026_10_08.n_synthetic_rh_appended_used=0`.
split: leave-one-metal-out: 5 folds (Ru/Ir/Os/Rh/Re) x 5 seeds = 25 runs, 30 epochs each, rh_oversample=0 (real-only)

synthetic_augmented_baseline_preserved_f.rationale: This block preserves the contaminated (n_synthetic_rh_appended=500) wave's headline so the diff vs the real-only wave is auditable on a single read. Per Wf-R40 P-A + Wf-R43 m19 fail-loud guard remediation: the contaminated number was HELD-OUT but not REAL-DATA-ONLY; the real-only re-measurement (top-level `value` above) is the headline that downstream consumers should quote going forward.

real_only_pa_m19_re_measurement_2026_10_.description: Wf-R40 P-A + Wf-R43 m19 REAL-DATA-ONLY re-measurement via --rh-oversample 0 (Wf-R40 P-A parameterization). Launcher: scripts/launch_dmpnn_clean5_lomo.sh with default RH_OVERSAMPLE=0 (per Wf-R40 1-line fix, commit adf7f6e29e). 5 metals (Ru/Ir/Os/Rh/Re) x 5 seeds x 30 epochs = 25 runs on CPU.

rh_real_only_lift_vs_synthetic_baseline.interpretation: The synthetic-Rh-augmented run REACHED Rh=0.88 because the appended 500 hard-coded active/inactive rows (IC50=0.1 vs IC50=10.0; pIC50=7.0 vs 5.0) supplied a clean active/inactive signal the Rh real-only pool lacks. Removing the synthetic rows (n_synthetic_rh_appended=0) drops Rh by -0.50, which is the size of the artificial lift. The 'synthetic_label_provenance_warning' field above is consistent with this drop.

real_only_pa_m19_re_measurement_2026_10_.honest_framing: Wf-R40 P-A 1-line fix (RH_OVERSAMPLE env var) made this re-measurement possible: with --rh-oversample hard-coded to 500, no real-only run was launchable. With default 0, the trainer's append_synthetic_rh_to_dataset() is a no-op (n=0), and the LOMO split sees only the real 5-metal pool. The honest takeaway: the 0.7577 pooled value was held-out BUT contaminated; the 0.5575 real-only pooled value is below the 0.7 GATE_AUC constant, below the 0.5 Rh random-baseline (Rh is genuinely hard), and below the 0.6 overall target. The headline is therefore BELOW 0.5 on Rh and BELOW 0.6 overall, NOT a reproduction of the 0.7577 number on the synthetic-augmented cohort. This is the right number to quote going forward; the synthetic-augmented number stays above for historical diff.
real_only_pa_m19_re_measurement_2026_10_.wf_tag: Wf-R40 + Wf-R43 m19 P-A real-only re-measurement

real_only_centering_reproduction_2026_10.description: F3 'TO CLOSE' item: reproduce the --per-metal-pic50-center lever end-to-end under the REAL-ONLY protocol (--rh-oversample 0), which every historical /tmp/f3_* run did NOT use (all 500-oversample, hence non-comparable to the 0.5575 headline). Runs executed on GPU cuda:0, same protocol as the headline (5 metals x 5 seeds x 30 epochs for the panel; Rh 1-metal x 5 seeds x 30 epochs for the fold + combination runs). No code changed; --per-metal-pic50-center and --alpha are pre-existing wired flags (train_metal_lomo_wasserstein.py:1045/1538 + :1737).
real_only_centering_reproduction_2026_10.launch_command: .venv/bin/python molmetal/scripts/train_metal_lomo_wasserstein.py --metals Ru Ir Os Rh Re --seeds 0 1 2 3 4 --epochs 30 --device cuda:0 --rh-oversample 0 --per-metal-pic50-center
real_only_centering_reproduction_2026_10.honest_framing: The +0.027 aggregate lift is INSIDE the run-level noise (value_std 0.0764 on the centering run, 0.0949 on the baseline) and is NOT a resolvable headline improvement; centering is METAL-DEPENDENT, not a uniform lift (helps hard folds Os +0.063 / Rh +0.121 / Re +0.032, hurts strong folds Ru -0.035 / Ir -0.046). The Rh-fold move IS decisive across seeds: baseline [0.378,0.431,0.353,0.381,0.363] vs centering [0.459,0.518,0.466,0.616,0.452], ZERO seed overlap, fold std 0.0265 -> 0.0613. Do NOT flip --per-metal-pic50-center to a default off this aggregate; the only real signal is the worst-fold (Rh) improvement.

alpha_lever_reproduction_rh_only.note: MEASURED in the planning session; per-seed values recorded in the F3 file's real-only block. Single-metal (Rh), NOT a 5-metal panel.

centering_plus_alpha1_combination_rh_onl.interpretation: centering (alpha=0.5) on Rh = 0.5022; adding alpha=1.0 (drop regression) drops it to 0.4185 (-0.084), i.e. WORSE than either centering alone (0.5022) or alpha=1.0 alone (0.4352). The two levers interfere: the centered regression auxiliary is helping, so removing it (alpha=1.0) hurts. Recommendation: use --per-metal-pic50-center ALONE (alpha default 0.5); do not combine with alpha=1.0.

real_only_centering_reproduction_2026_10.default_change_recommendation: NONE. Leave --alpha and --per-metal-pic50-center defaults unchanged. Recorded as a per-fold ablation only.

synthetic_label_provenance_warning: The synthetic Rh rows carry FABRICATED potency labels, not measured IC50. molmetal/scripts/train_metal_lomo_wasserstein.py::append_synthetic_rh_to_dataset hard-codes them: active rows get IC50_Dark_value=0.1 / pIC50=7.0, inactive rows IC50_Dark_value=10.0 / pIC50=5.0 (function body ~L595-605). Because the multitask regression head trains on pIC50 as well as the classification label, these constants are direct supervision on a fabricated target. Any pIC50 output from a wave that appended the synthetic Rh cohort is not a measurement. Separately, rows are filtered to Catherine-6/6-PASS Rh compounds in load_rh_synthetic_smiles (~L510-518), so the appended set is doubly non-representative of the real Rh chemical space.
real_only_fold_value_note: aligned to the live 25-run real-only measurement (real_only_pa_m19_re_measurement_2026_10_08); the prior 0.381 described the retracted 7-run synthetic wave, preserved under synthetic_augmented_baseline_preserved_for_diff

m1_w2_onoff_deconfound_2026_10_08.description: W1 clean real-only M1 ON/OFF ablation (de-confounds the W2 transfer term). Both arms are 25-run (5 metals x 5 seeds x 30 epochs), rh_oversample=0, real-only. OFF = the canonical headline run (dmpnn_clean5_lomo); ON = --wasserstein-real --wasserstein-weight 0.05 --wasserstein-cadence every-batch. Run on GPU cuda:0.
m1_w2_onoff_deconfound_2026_10_08.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE: turning the W2 transfer term ON (weight 0.05, every-batch) LOWERS the real-only LOMO aggregate by 0.023 (0.5575 -> 0.5349), driven by Re (-0.068). The W2 regulariser is not a lever for this metric. This also matches the G6 per-innovation ablation (no_wass vs no_multi_task on Ru/Rh: delta <= 0.008, inside seed std). De-confounds the earlier +0.049 claim, which was confounded by cadence.
m1_w2_onoff_deconfound_2026_10_08.caveat: n=5 seeds; per-fold AUC resolution on the small OOD folds (Rh n_test=108, Os n_test=87) is ~0.06, so Re's -0.068 is ~1 resolution unit of a 3668-test fold and is the one fold worth re-checking; Ru/Ir/Os/Rh moves are all below their fold resolution.

superseded_half_synthetic_baseline_note: SUPERSEDED BASELINE (describes the retracted 0.7577 number, NOT the live headline). HONEST-NEGATIVE (MEASURED, resolved to source, 2026-10-07 per wf-R33 m19 cohort-conflict): the 0.7577 mean pools 2 folds fed by the SAME synthetic Rh cohort -- wf139_p7_rh_active_cohort/synthetic_rh_pos_neg_normalized.json -- via append_synthetic_rh_to_dataset() with n_synthetic_rh_appended=500, confirmed identically on all 7 runs in molmetal/reports/wf131_p3_deferred_runs/run.log (n=27132, n_synthetic_rh_appended=500). The prior note claiming 'Re is real-only' is CORRECTED and RETRACTED: Re was NOT real-only. The synthetic block is appended to the shared 5-metal pool BEFORE the LOMO split, so it contaminates the Rh train fold AND enters the Re train fold too -- only the held-out TEST fold of each metal is clean, which is why the headline number is still a held-out measurement but not a real-data-only measurement. is_synthetic on the resolved cohort: the wf139_p7 file carries NO is_synthetic key; it is synthetic by construction (Rh_act_label_generation output, 250 simulated active + 250 simulated inactive). The wf387a2 balanced cohort's is_synthetic:false describes REAL compounds and was never used here. rh_cohort_source in this file previously pointed at wf387a2; that was a retroactive overwrite and is restored to the value the trainer actually wrote. Open honest-negative (unchanged): the trainer docstring predicts n_synthetic_rh_appended=500 waves land Rh at 0.338-0.411, but this wave MEASURED Rh=0.8798. The divergence is unexplained and is a result to investigate, not to celebrate.

headline_caveat: RETRACTED HEADLINE: the 0.5575 in this file is the 5-metal EQUAL-WEIGHT mean, and docs/PREDICTIVE_LINE_INDEX.md §3 (retraction log, dated 2026-10-19) withdrew the claim 「LOMO 0.5575，差 0.04」 and replaced it with the resolvable-subset 0.5974, because 0.5575 averages in the Rh 51 / Os 36 / Re 74 folds whose unique counts are below MIN_UNIQUE_FOR_GATE=200. The quotable figure per that index is 0.5974 (resolvable subset: Ru 1,311 / Ir 538), with 0.5947 as the seed-ensemble robustness, and the index's own instruction is 「以本索引和台账为准」, i.e. the index and the claim ledger (docs/CLAIM_LEDGER.md) take precedence over registry.py cite; 0.5575 must not be quoted as the LOMO headline. This 0.5575 also sits below the metric's own gate constant of 0.70 (gate_target: 0.7), which gate_target_provenance records as an INTERNAL GATE_AUC constant and NOT a literature value, and real_only_fold_value is 0.3812 (the Rh fold), the weakest fold in that equal-weight mean.
